title: Observational Study of Exposure to Environmental Toxicants Among Firefighters
official: Evaluate the Exposure to Toxicants Emitted During a Structural Fire Assessed by Urinary and Buccal Cell Biomarkers Found in Firefighters.
summary: Observational, within subject study design with 1 pre and 2 post-fire exposure biomarker samples collected to assess exposure to toxicants from combustion emissions related to fighting a structural fire.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Firefighter (career or volunteer)
* Over 18 years of age
* Able to provide written voluntary consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwilling to provide a pre and post-exposure urine sample
* Current cancer diagnosis
* Tobacco use within the last 1 year (verified by urinary TNEs)
sponsor: Masonic Cancer Center, University of Minnesota
